rows.label: Tingting
limits: 中英文、數字、中英夾雜都能念（英文帶中文口音）；聲音較機械。
Chinese, English, numbers and mixed text are fine (English with an accent); sounds robotic.

rows.label: Meijia
limits: 中英文、數字、中英夾雜都能念（英文帶中文口音）；聲音較機械。

rows.label: Kokoro 雲希
limits: 只能念中文（大陸口音）：數字 OK；整句英文改用 macOS Samantha 念，中文句子裡的英文字母（如 CNC）會被跳過。
Chinese only (Mainland accent): numbers are fine; English sentences go to macOS Samantha, and Latin letters inside Chinese (e.g. CNC) are skipped.

rows.label: Kokoro 曉北
limits: 只能念中文（大陸口音）：數字 OK；整句英文改用 macOS Samantha 念，中文句子裡的英文字母（如 CNC）會被跳過。

rows.label: Azure 雲哲
limits: 雲端（Azure AI Speech，美東區）：要能連網，要念的文字會上傳；邊合成邊回傳，連線建立後第一段聲音約 0.3 秒（每次開始的第一句約 1–2 秒）。台灣口音，中英文、數字都行；依字數付費（有免費額度）。

Cloud (Azure AI Speech, East US 2): needs the network and the text is uploaded; audio streams back while it is made, the first piece in about 0.3 s once connected (1-2 s for the very first line). Taiwanese accent; Chinese, English and numbers are fine; billed per character (free tier exists).

rows.label: Azure 曉雨
limits: 雲端（Azure AI Speech，美東區）：要能連網，要念的文字會上傳；邊合成邊回傳，連線建立後第一段聲音約 0.3 秒（每次開始的第一句約 1–2 秒）。台灣口音，中英文、數字都行；依字數付費（有免費額度）。

rows.label: MOSS-TTS-Nano 台灣腔
limits: 很快（每句約 0.6 秒），但常把句子拉長、重複（88 秒的稿念成 183 秒），測試台詞辨識錯字率約 45%，不建議使用；繁體字要先轉簡體。
Fast (about 0.6 s a sentence) but often stretches and repeats lines (an 88 s script took 183 s), 45% errors on the test lines: not recommended; reads Simplified.

rows.label: Azure 曉臻
limits: 雲端（Azure AI Speech，美東區）：要能連網，要念的文字會上傳；邊合成邊回傳，連線建立後第一段聲音約 0.3 秒（每次開始的第一句約 1–2 秒）。台灣口音，中英文、數字都行；依字數付費（有免費額度）。

rows.label: MediaTek VITS
limits: 只會念中文字：數字先轉成國字再念，整句英文改用 macOS Samantha，中文句子裡的英文字母（如 CNC）會被跳過；咬字較不清楚、每次念的長度不一（回聽錯字率約 11%，測試台詞約 17%），短句常吞字，不適合當測試講者。

Chinese characters only: numbers are spelled out first, English sentences go to macOS Samantha, Latin letters inside Chinese (e.g. CNC) are skipped; less clear and uneven (about 11% round-trip errors, 17% on the test lines), drops syllables of short lines, not a good test speaker.

rows.label: Qwen3-TTS Uncle Fu
limits: 中英文都能念（官方支援 10 種語言），數字、中英夾雜 OK；繁體字會走音，所以先轉簡體再念；整句合成每句約 1.2–1.7 秒，助理已改成邊合成邊播，約 0.2 秒開口。

Chinese and English (10 languages), numbers and mixed text are fine; Traditional characters are mispronounced, so it reads Simplified; 1.2-1.7 s per whole sentence, but the assistant plays it while it is made and starts in about 0.2 s.

rows.label: Qwen3-TTS Vivian
limits: 中英文都能念（官方支援 10 種語言），數字、中英夾雜 OK；繁體字會走音，所以先轉簡體再念；整句合成每句約 1.2–1.7 秒，助理已改成邊合成邊播，約 0.2 秒開口。

Chinese and English (10 languages), numbers and mixed text are fine; Traditional characters are mispronounced, so it reads Simplified; 1.2-1.7 s per whole sentence, but the assistant plays it while it is made and starts in about 0.2 s.

rows.label: OmniVoice 台灣腔
limits: 中英文、數字都行；繁體字會走音，所以先轉簡體再念；每句約 1.5 秒才開口，即時對話稍慢；測試台詞串流辨識全對，很適合當測試講者。

Chinese, English and numbers are fine; Traditional characters are mispronounced, so it reads Simplified; about 1.5 s before each sentence, a little slow to talk live; every test line was recognised right, a good test speaker.

30 languages, mixed text and numbers are fine; reads Simplified; slow (about 3.6 s a sentence), pre-render only.

rows.label: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS
limits: 雲端（Google Vertex AI）：要能連網，要念的文字會上傳；整句生成完才回傳，加上網路往返，每句要等數秒。中英文、數字都行；口音偏大陸。

Cloud (Google Vertex AI): needs the network and the text is uploaded; it returns the whole sentence at once, so with the round trip each sentence takes seconds. Chinese, English and numbers are fine; Mainland accent.
